findings.source_quote: This poem was inspired by the Scripture passage in Jeremiah 18:1-6.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “धर्मशास्त्र के उस अंश” with “बाइबल के उस अंश” (or “पवित्रशास्त्र के उस अंश”) so the phrase refers clearly to Scripture, not theology.
findings.translation_quote: यह कविता यिर्मयाह 18:1-6 में दिए गए धर्मशास्त्र के उस अंश से प्रेरित थी।

findings.source_quote: What kind of vessel will I be:
findings.suggested_fix: Change “बनूँगा” to “बनूँगी” to match the feminine speaker used later in the poem (“मानती हूँ,” “टकराती हूँ”).
